claim_text: Guy Peleg 'didn't do army' and 'was released after two days.'
discovery_sources: Walla contemporaneous broadcast report; Kipa correction report; 2026-08-31 Tel Aviv Magistrate's Court judgment reporting via ICE and Srugim
resolution_notes: Court reporting states Judge Roi Shahar found the statement a false factual assertion: Peleg completed full regular military service and then served 16 years in the reserves. Magal corrected the claim on air days later. The court dismissed the claim against Channel 14 itself because the statement was made live and could not reasonably have been anticipated; attribution is therefore to presenter Yinon Magal, not Channel 14 editorial speech.
media_status: Exact claim-specific screenshot/words are preserved in Walla; no durable standalone asset/stable GitHub preview recovered, so no substitute imagery was used.
